# Briefings

Auto-generated by Claude agents. Do not edit manually — they'll be overwritten.

## Structure

```
briefings/
├── daily/
│   └── YYYY-MM-DD.md     # morning brief for that day
├── weekly/
│   └── YYYY-WNN.md       # Monday all-hands or Friday retro
└── monthly/
    └── YYYY-MM.md        # board-format monthly review
```

## Generated by

| Briefing | Command | Agent |
|---|---|---|
| Daily | `/morning-brief` | intel-lead → morning-briefer |
| Weekly (Monday) | `/weekly-allhands` | intel-lead |
| Weekly (Friday) | `/weekly-retro` | intel-lead |
| Monthly | `/monthly` | intel-lead → all dept leads |

## Reading briefs

Briefs are committed to git so there's an audit trail. Check git log for briefing history.
